lines.zh: 我黑得像一块炭，走在暗处看不见
lines.en: Black as charcoal, I vanish in shadow.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片边上有暗红的光
lines.en: A dull red light edges my scales.

lines.zh: 我小跑时，脚下留下灰印
lines.en: I leave ashen prints as I trot.

lines.zh: 我的膝折着，走得一颠一颠
lines.en: My knees are folded; I bob as I walk.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，尽量不离太远
lines.en: I follow you, never straying far.
My wings are heavier than my body.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边绕到另一边
lines.en: I move from one side of your feet to the other.
The tip of my tail runs hot.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都干了
lines.en: The grass dries where I pass.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛发暗光
lines.en: I look up at you, my eyes dimly lit.

lines.zh: 我踩到一块石头，绊了一下
lines.en: I trip over a stone.

lines.zh: 我停在你前面，等你跟上
lines.en: I stop ahead of you and wait.
Nether ash still clings to me.
I walk while flicking my tail.

lines.zh: 我趴在阴凉处，鳞片吸着光
lines.en: I lie in the shade, my scales drinking the light.
My black gives nothing back.
I hatched in the nether.
The air there was hotter than here.
A little fire sits in my throat.
I rest my head on your boot.
I seldom cry out; my cry is dry.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰落了一小块
lines.en: A flake of ash falls off me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，瞳孔缩成一条线
lines.en: I look up, my pupils narrowed to slits.
The wind here is too cool.
Firelight moves over my black scales.
I wait for you to call me over.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼里的光斜着照上来
lines.en: I lift my head, the light in my eyes slanting up.
You are gentler than nether rock.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，凑到你手边
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand.
You touch me; I will not burn you.

lines.zh: 我的黑鳞底下是暗红的
lines.en: Under my black scales it is dull red.
You smell clean.
I sit, tail curled at my feet.
I open my mouth; no fire comes.
When you speak, I listen.
I am not grown; my flight is unsteady.
I lean against your leg.
Lower your hand a little.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我不怕
lines.en: Your shadow covers me; I am not afraid.
I make a small sound.
I'm red as burnt coal.
I retreat behind your legs.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的黑鳞掀了一片
lines.en: That peeled up a shard of my black scale.
I cried out, my throat dry.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口热气，没有火
lines.en: I breathe out heat, no fire.
I go down, then push back up.
My wings are too heavy to lift.
That taught me what pain is.
I press against you; do not go.
My scales are not hard enough yet.

lines.zh: 我记住了这个东西的味道
lines.en: I remember the smell of this thing.
Meat, give it here.
I circle your hand.
Not enough; I am growing.

lines.zh: 我咬得很快，怕你收回去
lines.en: I bite fast, afraid you will take it back.
I puffed a little fire on it.
It is scorched, but I will still eat it.
I take it and retreat to the corner.
Hold still; let me smell it.
I lick your hand when I am done.
You bump me and my feet slip.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很硬，你别太用力
lines.en: My scales are hard; do not push too hard.
I am shoved two steps, then return.

lines.zh: 这一下把灰都撞起来了
lines.en: That knocked the ash up.
I shake, and ash falls everywhere.
You steady me, and I hold.

lines.zh: 我被顶开两步，又自己回来。
lines.en: I am shoved back two steps and come back myself.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的翅膀比身体大。
lines.en: Sorry — my wings are bigger than I am.
I am young; that is far off.
You are the only one I know.

lines.zh: 下界里我只认得石头和火
lines.en: In the nether I knew only stone and fire.
Now I know you.

lines.zh: 等我长大了，我带你去看下界
lines.en: When I am grown, I will show you the nether.
Sleeping beside you is enough.
I will not wander off on my own.

lines.zh: 我把最热的那侧朝外，替你挡风
lines.en: I turn my warmest side outward to block the wind.
Lean on me when you are cold.
We will speak of it later.
I pick it up; ash gets in my mouth.
This thing is cold.
I push it to you with a claw.
It is bigger than my head.
I hold it, my tail still wagging.
I bite; it will not give.
I drag it toward the fire.
I set it before your feet.
I can still carry this much.
It fell; I did not pick it up.
I check your face first.
I drop low, fire in my throat.
I could try this one.
My black scales have lifted.
With you behind me, I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我的颜色帮了忙
lines.en: It has not seen me; my color helps.
I give one low cry.
I walk toward it.
I strike only if you say so.
The tip of my tail has caught fire.
I wait for your nod.
I follow through the grass, low.

lines.zh: 我的黑色在暗处很好用
lines.en: My black serves me in shadow.
It moves; my head follows.

lines.zh: 我不出声，火压在喉咙里
lines.en: I make no sound; the fire stays down.
I stay close to you.
It backs behind stone; I go around.

lines.zh: 我的腿短，但我一直在靠近
lines.en: Short legs, and I keep closing.

lines.zh: 地面的震动告诉我它在哪
lines.en: Tremors tell me where it is.
I wait for it to lower its head.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我后面，我听得见
lines.en: I hear your steps behind me.
Your steps stopped. I hear it.

lines.zh: 我把身体压到你膝盖的高度
lines.en: I sink to your knee height.
This is the final time.
I am lunging now.
My claws are small, but they hold.
That one carried fire.
I breathed once; the ground chars.
My head knocked it back.
I whip my head and tear a strip.
Knocked away, I charge again.
Sparks land on my black scales.
It is bigger; I make up with speed.
I cry out and press in.
You are watching, so I must win.
I pull back, panting hard.
That will be remembered.
I return to your feet.

lines.zh: 黑色的壳裂开，我爬了出来
lines.en: The black shell split and I crawled out.

lines.zh: 我出生在下界的一块岩上
lines.en: I was born on a nether rock.
The air here is too cool.

lines.zh: 我第一口气就带出火星
lines.en: My first breath brought sparks.

lines.zh: 我落地时烫了地面一下
lines.en: My landing scorched the ground.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来就认得你的手
lines.en: I knew your hand from the moment I hatched.
My scales are not fully hardened.
I look toward the fire.
I push into your palm.

lines.zh: 这里的颜色我都不认得
lines.en: I do not know any of these colors.
I cried once, dryly.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，光是新的
lines.en: I raise my head; the light is new.
I steady myself at your feet.
I have decided to follow you.
I try opening my wings.
I poke my head out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 火对我来说不算什么，但我还小
lines.en: Fire means little to me, but I am small.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，灰和火星一起散开
lines.en: I hit the ground; ash and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，我难受得直挣
lines.en: Water hits me; I thrash in discomfort.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，火从嘴里漏出来
lines.en: The blast flips me and fire leaks from my mouth.
An arrow sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力压住我喉咙里的火
lines.en: That force presses down the fire in my throat.

lines.zh: 我饿得喉咙里的火都弱了
lines.en: Hunger has dimmed the fire in my throat.

lines.zh: 雷光打下来，我贴在你脚边
lines.en: Lightning flashes; I press to your feet.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我张翅也抓不住
lines.en: No ground; my wings catch nothing.
